Hi Sarah — great to meet you on the call. Looping in Marissa (CS lead) and Connor (implementation PM). Attached is a concise 2-week checklist + the sprint plan we intend to run. Key points up front: 

- Access: please add these two service accounts and one admin user to your VPC allowlist (instructions in the PDF).
- Endpoints: we’ll provision a dedicated inference endpoint for sandbox testing (dev-1.launchpad.acme).
- Pre-seed data: CSV with columns [id, prompt, expected_output, confidence_threshold]. Sample row included.

We recorded today’s demo — I’m including the recording bundle and timestamps for the short clips your leads will find useful. If it helps we can carve out two 30-minute async office-hour blocks (US morning / US late afternoon) this week so your eng leads can drop in without blocking calendar time.

Next steps: 
1) Marissa to own scheduling & recording notes.
2) Connor to share initial MA P (mutual action plan) template and draft timeline.
3) Sarah/Tom to confirm allowlist + who will be admin.

-Rafael

Attachments: Launchpad_Onboarding_Sprint_Plan_v1.pdf; Async_OfficeHours_ZoomRecordings.zip

Tom/Sarah — quick follow up with the security checklist (see bullet summary below) and confirmed IP ranges we’ll announce from our infra: 35.201.0.0/18 and 34.79.64.0/18. I’ve also added Laura from Solutions to jump in on any procurement/security exceptions.

Security checklist (short):
- TLS enforced on all endpoints (we supply certs by default)
- Audit log delivery: optional S3 push, retention 90 days by default (customizable)
- Data handling: no customer PII persisted on shared sandbox; option to enable dedicated private deployment for regulated data
- SOC2 evidence: we can share the self-service security pack and current SOC2 summary on request

I’ll upload the short checklist PDF to the Drive and drop the recording clips there after Wed’s session. Wed 09:00 PT is confirmed unless I hear a blocking conflict.

Connor

Attachments referenced: security_checklist_short.pdf
